retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the umbrella item for the Russian Revolution of 1917. The atlas already holds the thing itself in three records with dates, actors and edges of their own — the February revolution, the October revolution and the civil war — and a fourth node covering all three would double every path through them in the graph and the timeline without adding an argument. Nothing here is lost: the period is walkable from February to October to the civil war.

title: Russian Revolution
summary: Wikidata item Q8729, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1917-1922 political change in Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
